ExcelsisView invokes the separate `dwg2dxf` command-line program to provide
read-only DWG viewing. The binary and matching source are redistributed under
GPL-3.0-or-later.

Pinned upstream commit:
  c34d1efb8fce8dfcd5bd7b4308c0d5e0b9de0a30

Official release:
  https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/releases/tag/0.14.8492

Official binary asset:
  libredwg-0.14.8492-win64.zip
  SHA-256: 7905b41d507d8e4d817bc209507addc9e3ada61d66316350d4ad3de85238b189

Matching source included with the application:
  libredwg-0.14.8492-source.tar.gz
  SHA-256: 9935245817278c944c681527ef52eee81ccf720fce09f9fb467d0d6a926ae3ce

This snapshot postdates and includes the fixes released in 0.14.8413 for
CVE-2026-15181, CVE-2026-15184, and CVE-2026-9529, in addition to the earlier
fixes tracked for CVE-2026-9502, CVE-2026-9503, CVE-2026-9530, and
CVE-2026-15520. Native execution is additionally placed inside an
ExcelsisView AppContainer and bounded by a Windows Job Object.
